'''Saku Shrine''' (佐久神社) is a Japanese shrine. Several shrines with the same name are located primarily in Shizuoka Prefecture and Yamanashi Prefecture.

* {{ill|Saku Shrine (Kofu)|ja|佐久神社 (甲府市)}} - A shrine located in Kofu City, Yamanashi Prefecture. Relocated by the feudal lord Kōzan Izumo no Kami in the 13th year of Tenbun (1543).
* {{ill|Saku Shrine (Fuefuki)|ja|佐久神社 (笛吹市)}} - A shrine located in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Saku Shrine (Shizuoka)|ja|佐久神社 (静岡市)}} - A shrine located in Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
== See Also ==
* {{ill|Sakunado Shrine|ja|佐久奈度神社}} - A shrine located in Ōtsu City, Shiga Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ihasaku Shrine|ja|伊波佐久神社}} - A shrine located in Toyama City, Toyama Prefecture.
